notes.title: Build 105
notes.content: Fixed a minor issue involving the navigator

notes.title: Game release
notes.content:
The game is now released! The soundtrack as well.

If you have any questions, comments, concerns or require help, please post on the Steam forums or email: Support@EFUniverseGames.com

notes.title: Release Delay
notes.content: The game was originally set to release on February 24th, however, a handful of technical issues could not be fixed before release. As a result, the release date will be pushed back to March 23rd.
